limits: 调用边分级：exact=限定名/同类唯一命中；name=全工作区唯一同名；ambig=存在多个同名符号；unresolved=目标不在工作区索引内。页面不把 name/ambig/unresolved 显示为确定链路。
函数识别基于定义行+花括号匹配：宏生成函数、模板特化、未闭合花括号的宏体可能漏提。
字段的 设置/清除/修改/读取 分类是 RHS 字面量与方法名的模式匹配，非语义分析；读取点计数为完整计数，列表在超上限时截断（面板注明）。
「保留(未见清除)」表示静态索引中未发现清除/复位点，是启发式结论，不是运行时证明。
回调接线依据 create_subscription 处的 std::bind / self.cb 文本；lambda 回调记为 <lambda>；定时器与服务回调未索引。
对象成员调用（obj->method()）仅在能从成员声明类型推断接收者类时入图；接收者类型无法静态推断时不建边，避免猜测。

fields.name: rolling_task_handoff
fields.comment: First cross-task candidate must connect motion, not merely position.

fields.name: handoff_certified
fields.comment: Local certifies this exact initial match and align-then-connect motion. Controller must not independently choose a different trajectory prefix. Moving task candidates require the certificate; stationary HOLD is exempt.

fields.name: handoff_turn_position_allowance
fields.comment: Execution envelope certified by Local in addition to the installation error. Zero retains the legacy 0.02 m bound. Positive values are limited to 0.10 m.

fields.name: handoff_alignment_tolerance
fields.comment: Local certifies the residual yaw band for turn AND departure. Zero retains 0.05 rad; positive grants must lie in [0.05, 0.12] rad.

fields.name: use_measured_progress
fields.comment: Match progress to the measured body independently of speed limits/calibration. False retains reference-time tracking for explicitly time-indexed callers. Fixed-yaw lateral recovery owns measured capture through its own primitive.

fields.name: min_forward_command
fields.comment: Explicit planner-authorized forward gait calibration; zero disables it.

fields.name: forward_stage_stop_latency
fields.comment: Required for MODE_FORWARD_TURN_STAGE. Local and Controller use the same conservative braking contract; these values do not widen the capture region.

fields.name: terminal_speed_limit
fields.comment: A low-speed transit endpoint constrains only its braking approach, not the entire otherwise wide trajectory. Zero disables this additional bound.

consts.name: MODE_NORMAL
consts.comment: The planner and controller share one execution contract. Zero numeric limits select controller defaults. Schema changes require rebuilding all consumers.

consts.name: MODE_FORWARD_TURN_STAGE
consts.comment: Rest-to-rest straight conversion; fixed body yaw, bounded capture and braking.

fields.name: certificate_stamp
fields.comment: Used only by COMMAND_REFRESH_TURN; the request/task/trajectory must match.

consts.name: COMMAND_REFRESH_TURN
consts.comment: Refresh an executing initial turn only after Local rechecks the complete remaining rotation, reconnection and physical braking sweep. Never resumes HOLD.

fields.name: failed_object_id
fields.comment: Stable topology ID for PORTAL / REGION; task-local stable ID for VIEWPOINT.

fields.name: trajectory_id
fields.comment: Candidate trajectory whose path failed validation; it may not be ACKed.

fields.name: has_path_segment
fields.comment: PATH evidence is task-local geometry. It is not an occupancy observation.

fields.name: occupancy
fields.comment: Raw measured slice at origin.z: 100 occupied, 0 observed free, -1 unknown. No inflation and no hazard projection: clearance is Global's contract.

fields.name: scan
fields.comment: Local terrain scan counter this patch was built from.

fields.name: content_revision
fields.comment: Changes only when raw occupancy or terrain tiles change materially.

fields.name: terrain_tiles
fields.comment: Terrain summaries for the 2 m tiles overlapping this patch window.

fields.name: route_graph_revision
fields.comment: Execution topology cursor only; must NEVER count as observed information.

fields.name: trigger_reason
fields.comment: Preserve the causal chain when a failed escape cannot rejoin its task.

consts.name: EXECUTION_BLOCKED
consts.comment: Current execution/path failure; not spatial evidence against a viewpoint.

consts.name: PATH_REJECTED
consts.comment: Local path candidates exhausted; retry the route before rejecting the station.

consts.name: EXECUTION_READY
consts.comment: Exact task/request/candidate was installed and ACKed by Controller.

consts.name: LOCAL_MOTION_EXHAUSTED
consts.comment: Local bounded motion search/budget exhausted. NOT proof of an impassable viewpoint, portal or region; Explorer alone decides another task.

consts.name: TRANSITION_WAIT_STOP
consts.comment: Same successor identity. Phase events grant neither motion nor completion.

consts.name: FAILURE_ACTION
consts.comment: Failure scope never grants motion or proves a remote route impassable.

fields.name: predecessor_task_id
fields.comment: Normal observation completion may replace this predecessor without stopping its safe execution prefix. Cancellation/supersession still uses stop-first.

fields.name: coarse_route
fields.comment: Allowed domain: corridor around coarse_route UNION observation disk.

fields.name: local_geometry_autonomy
fields.comment: False preserves the legacy geometric progress guards. True makes the route a domain/approach hint, not an executable path or an observation ledger.

fields.name: route_graph_revision
fields.comment: Empty: explicit geometric-domain fallback (NOT topological progress). Nonempty: ordered directed checkpoints; frozen for this task/version.

fields.name: target_cells
fields.comment: Spatially distributed representatives; NOT the completion denominator.

fields.name: has_directional_gate
fields.comment: Optional world-space no-return gate inherited from region commitment.

consts.name: ACTIVE
consts.comment: Explorer owns completion. Local goal changes do not change task_version. Objective / lineage changes require a newer version or a new task_id.

fields.name: connection_id
fields.comment: A directed checkpoint on an actually selected sparse graph connection. Identity is valid only within ObservationTask.route_graph_revision.

fields.name: ground_min          # world z (m); NaN when no measured ground column
slope               # rad, least-squares plane over per-column ground points; NaN if < 3
roughness           # m, RMS residual of that plane; NaN if < 3
support_cells        # columns whose lowest and highest facts are within floor tolerance
rise_cells           # columns with a body-height rise fact
drop_cells           # columns with a drop fact
overhead_cells       # columns with an overhead fact above the body top
measured_columns     # columns holding at least one measured height fact
last_scan            # Local terrain scan counter of the freshest fact in the tile
content_revision     # hash of this summary, changes only when content changes

consts.name: tile_x                # world tile index, tile origin
consts.comment: One world-aligned square tile of Local terrain evidence. Ground statistics are derived from measured ground-height facts only: a cell without a measured height is not assumed flat, it is simply not counted.  Counts are per measured column and non-exclusive (a column can carry both drop and rise evidence).

fields.name: ground_min
fields.comment: Terrain and experience aggregated by Global along this edge's polyline. traversability is a route-cost multiplier in [0.8, 2.0], never a hard block.

fields.name: ground_min
fields.comment: Terrain and experience aggregated by Global over this node's footprint. traversability is a route-cost multiplier in [0.8, 2.0], never a hard block.

consts.name: STATUS_ACTIVATED
consts.comment: Task-mode installation results. ACCEPTED remains a legacy-only adapter.
